curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Finish the pickup bed rule with its exemptions and penalty, then the heat danger of a parked car and carbon monoxide from a blocked exhaust.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on pickup bed exemptions and parked-car hazards.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach crosswalk right of way without signals, pedestrians following signals, green and turning cars, finishing a crossing, blind pedestrians, Walk signals, and the horn and yield duties.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for green versus red and pedestrian signals versus traffic lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a pedestrian at an intersection and asking who goes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the school bus speed limit and hours, the stop rule and how long it lasts, then which traffic must stop on each road layout.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each layout and rule; contrast cards for when the stop ends and both-direction versus following-only layouts.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a road layout and asking who must stop.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain emergency vehicle right of way and pulling over, the one yielding exception, parking and following distances, then the move-over law for two lanes and one lane.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the exception, the distances and the move-over choices.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what to do near emergency vehicles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through signaling and pulling right, what to do with no safe place, confirming an unmarked car, and how to wait with hands visible.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each step; a contrast card for slowing with flashers versus stopping in a lane.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on the first minutes of a traffic stop.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the duty to identify and show documents, weapons, staying in the car, signing tickets, resisting an officer, and reporting misconduct.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for duty versus choice.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on rights and duties during a stop.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover failing to signal around motorcycles, then farm equipment crash patterns, passing rules and required lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card on when passing farm equipment is advisable.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on sharing the road with farm machinery.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec07-m01..sec07-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Pedestrians, school buses, emergency vehicles and police stops
School bus, emergency vehicle and pedestrian confusables

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
